title: Two Rooks, One File
setup: Your rooks are doubled on the open d-file, and Black's queen has just stepped off it to b6.
hint: Black's queen is the only guard on the eighth rank. What happens if it is made to capture?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} is not a blunder. It is an invitation. The king cannot move and the queen cannot block from b6, so {{Qxd8}} is forced, and the second rook mates with {{Rxd8#}}. Two attackers beat one defender on the back rank every time.
